approval: Owner approved HF uploads for experimentally working models with licenses preserved (2026-10-27). The precision is chosen per dispatch from the recipes below; a recipe with a precision_receipt is refused unless that receipt shows every case token-ID exact.

license_file.note: The model repository declares license: apache-2.0 but ships no LICENSE file (tree at the pinned revision checked 2026-10-28); the verbatim Apache-2.0 text is taken from the upstream code repository at its MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 release commit, the last commit touching LICENSE (byte-identical on main 50b74eba on 2026-10-28).

notice_file.note: Neither the Hub repository nor the code repository at the pinned commit has a NOTICE file (HTTP 404, 2026-10-28), so none is redistributed; the card carries the attribution and statement of changes required by Apache-2.0 section 4.

Q8_0.from_note: Quantized from the F16 GGUF exactly as qualified in the precision receipt: crispembed-quantize flattens 4-D F32 tensors, which the runtime rejects for v.emb.patch_embedding.weight.

Q4_K_MIX.from_note: Named policy minicpm_q4k_v1 (docs/minicpm-ocr-q4k.md): decoder, merger and tied embedding Q4_K, vision FFN IQ4_NL, vision attention Q8_0, ViT merger 4-bit; patch embedding and the 4304-wide vision fc2 F16.

qualification.receipts_precision: F32 and F16 conversions, 5 cases, token-ID exact vs Transformers 5.21.0 (CPU, greedy)
qualification.q8_0: publishable only when the precision receipt shows every q8_0 case token-ID exact; tests/results/minicpm-ocr/bench.json (b42e094d) shows 5/5 exact at 2 and 4 threads
qualification.registry_alias: TODO(follow-up after upload): add a registry alias with the real published SHA256; none is added here

card_quality.status_md: **Status per file.** F16 and Q8_0 are **recommended** (token-ID exact against the original on every frozen case). **Experimental: Q4_K_MIX** - it clears the owner's Q4_K final-logit cosine bar (> 0.94) but is not token-ID exact on every case; do not use it where exact agreement with the original matters.
